items.title: Man Utd captain Fernandes not for sale despite Galatasaray interest
items.description: Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes is not for sale at any price despite interest from Galatasaray.

items.title: Arsenal's trip to Liverpool and Leeds vs Man Utd live on Sky Sports
items.description: Liverpool's home matches against Manchester City and Arsenal, plus Manchester United's trip to rivals Leeds, are among the 21 Premier League games being shown live on Sky Sports in October and November.

items.title: All done deals in August 2026
items.description: Check out the significant signings and departures in the Premier League, Scottish Premiership, EFL and Women's Super League.

items.title: Ipswich sign midfielder Ouattara from Strasbourg
items.description: Ipswich Town complete the signing of midfielder Abdoul Ouattara from French club Strasbourg.

items.title: How Hunt struck gold with historic Championships display
items.description: Amy Hunt told Sky Sports back in February that three gold medals in Birmingham was the dream. Six months later, she is a four-time European champion and the first athlete to win four golds at a single European Championships.

items.title: How Penrice's dream debut helped ignite McInnes' Rangers reign
items.description: Amid a four-game winless start to the season, the arrival of James Penrice came with little fanfare, but the left-back played an unlikely role in igniting Rangers' season.

items.title: Martinez in limbo, with Villa future uncertain
items.description: Aston Villa goalkeeper Emi Martinez is facing an uncertain future after his proposed move to Juventus collapsed.

items.title: Man Utd will reject any bid for Fernandes
items.description: Manchester United have no intention of selling captain Bruno Fernandes despite Turkish club Galatasaray being prepared to lodge a bid for the 31-year-old later this week.

items.title: Man City move for £85m Bouaddi and still want Fernandez
items.description: Manchester City are in advanced talks with Lille over a move for Morocco midfielder Ayyoub Bouaddi.

items.title: Send us your Scotland World Cup memories of Boston
items.description: BBC Scotland is looking for Scotland supporters to send us their videos, audio and memories of that magical week or so in Boston at the World Cup.

items.title: MCC Female Young Broadcaster of the Year joins Hundred final coverage
items.description: The MCC Female Young Broadcaster of the Year for 2026, Rosa Simkin, received the ultimate competition prize when joining Sky Sports' live coverage of The Hundred final at Lord's on Sunday.

items.title: From Chelsea bomb squad to new chapter at Como for Chalobah
items.description: After ending his near 20-year association with Chelsea by joining Como 1907 this summer, Trevoh Chalobah credits his time at Stamford Bridge with building his resilience.
